scope: CPU-only offline retrieval software behavior and latency; no model, engine, service, production-distribution, complete recall or agent-efficacy claim

fixture.construction: Independent source-content judgements made without retrieval rankings; synthetic questions, not private production logs or a statistically representative sample.
fixture.release: Withheld text and labels must not be read by the runtime author or orchestrator before the candidate revision and runtime source digest are fixed. Freeze manifest commits their exact bytes.

entries.context_material: Same relevance call with material=True, max_bytes=1048576, context_bytes=65536
entries.default_diagnostic: KnowledgeReader.collect(query=cue, repo='inferrsi', backend=case_backend, limit=5); report separately

answerable_metrics: Success@5 = mean(any labelled relevant identity in ordered top five))
MRR@5 = mean(1 / first labelled relevant rank), or zero if absent
quality.denominator: Answerable cases only; report entrypoint and development/withheld splits plus per-case judgements. Labels identify defensible relevant results, not an exhaustive relevance inventory. Do not call this Recall.
quality.no_answer: Separate count, returned identities and no_match behavior; do not include in Success/MRR and do not treat empty lists as proof that the corpus has no answer.
quality.equivalence: All four modes on every case must have exactly equal canonical JSON bytes between revisions, including order, omissions, resource hashes, revisions, material and context budgets. Retain byte count, SHA-256 and readable projection of each exact output.

performance.order: Pair 0 AB, pair 1 BA, alternating for 10 groups of each order. A=baseline, B=candidate. Each side runs in a new isolated subprocess, sequentially. No concurrency.
performance.warmup: One untimed hot relevance collect per hot case on the same KnowledgeReader, followed by one default dev05 and one context_material dev09 warmup before measurements; record reader record/library cache population. Reuse this reader for hot measurements. Cold measurement creates a new reader inside the timed interval. OS filesystem caches are not evicted or claimed cold.
api_workloads: hot and fresh-reader relevance for all four hot cases
search for all four hot cases
hot and fresh-reader default collect using dev05
hot and fresh-reader context_material using dev09
performance.timing: perf_counter_ns around API call only; output serialization/hashing outside API timer. Warm measurements include normal output construction. Raw nanoseconds retained per query/pair/side/mode.
performance.cli: Separate full process subprocess.run([same_python, '-S', '-m', 'inferrsi', ...]), UTF-8 decode+JSON parse timing and raw stdout SHA-256/byte count. search uses --repo-type inferrsi; collect does not expose repo/backend filters and is explicitly an unfiltered CLI diagnostic. No CLI numbers pooled into the hot-API gate.
performance.summaries: Per mode/query/side p50 and p95 from all raw observations using linear interpolation at (n-1)*p. No trimming, outlier removal, retries or stopped-run pooling.
performance.primary_estimator: For each pair, take median of its four hot relevance query latencies for each side. Paired reduction r_i = 1 - median(candidate_queries_i) / median(baseline_queries_i). Report median(r_i). Each pair is one resampling unit, preserving its query set.

bootstrap.method: percentile bootstrap of paired reductions; each draw samples 20 reductions with replacement, then computes their median

performance.limits: Machine background load and filesystem-cache state remain observational limits. This is neither OS-cache-cold nor an engine/service benchmark. Cold/API/CLI regressions reported individually. Estimated bounded run length 5-10 minutes; actual elapsed and every completed sample retained. An incomplete run is INCONCLUSIVE.
performance.completeness: Before summary/gating require pair IDs exactly 0..19 once each with prescribed alternating AB/BA order and each side's exact16 API plus4 CLI case-by-mode set, no duplicates or extras. Quality requires the complete expected24x4 output set per side. Missing/duplicate/extra structure is INCONCLUSIVE and cannot satisfy the performance gate.

source_control.loading: Explicit checkout/src overrides editable installs; -S excludes site initializers and editable hooks. Explicit exceptions verify inferrsi, catalog, knowledge_operations and CLI resolved inside requested source tree. Critical checks do not use removable Python assertions. Children set PYTHONOPTIMIZE=0 and record sys.flags.optimize; parent optimization is recorded. Same interpreter for both versions.
source_control.identity: Record explicit git HEAD, dirty tracked-source status, all Python source relative-path SHA-256s and aggregate; all shipped repo_packs/**/*.json, knowledge_packs files and entire skill_library relative-path file SHA-256s, aggregate, counts and bytes. This covers contribution, dependency and peer records plus their package and library resources. Ignore incidental __pycache__/.pyc only. No personal absolute paths or host names in artifacts.
source_control.corpus: Both variants must have exactly equal complete shipped corpus digest; do not use a reduced custom corpus. Corpus inventory covers all shipped records and library resources, not merely retrieved items.
source_control.freezing: Freeze protocol, fixture and validator scripts in plan/freeze.json before candidate timing. Separate withheld fixture remains sealed until candidate freeze. A validator change requires a new freeze manifest and explanation; never silently amend frozen evidence.

diagnostics.profile: Optional baseline-only cProfile with relative/sanitized source labels; keep counts, total and cumulative times. Profiling time is excluded from benchmark samples.
diagnostics.trace_129: Execute distinct search, default, relevance and context/material modes on an independently authored development cue; record selection method/ranking flag, revisions, context resource roles and omissions. This tests merged #129 delivery code paths, not historical #128 task efficacy.
diagnostics.integrity: Mutation/stale-index/dependency/path/checkout/revision regression tests belong to runtime patch verification; evaluator parity does not replace them.

verdict: FAIL for observed parity/metric/performance-gate failure; INCONCLUSIVE for missing required measurements or unequal/unverified corpus/source; PASS only for this bounded CPU retrieval campaign after all required evidence and independent review. Merge/issue closure remains with acceptance owner.
